parsed.post: Discarding my last run (1.066); it was worse than my best (1.015). It seems the combination of DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.05 is sensitive. I will revert to my best commit and test reducing the batch size to 262144 to see if we get more optimizer steps with this deeper model.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (commit 0253532) and reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute window.
